objective: Deliver a bounded, reviewable decision and candidate prompts for slim Lead, on-demand Lead, or Lead-free delivery, preserving human pauses and independent financial/model review.

checks.description: Independent review of scoped artifacts, relevant focused behavior checks and Human acceptance; execution evidence recorded at implementation time.

acceptance.description: Compare the three viable operating modes within the one-person-day timebox, using current local evidence, ownership costs, risks and an explicit recommended pilot with stop/continue criteria.

Deliver concise candidate skill/coordination/report prompts and a role-responsibility map, showing actual UTF-8 byte counts and unavailable telemetry honestly; preserve pauses, resource gates, review and recovery semantics.

Replay completed-ticket preservation, busy owner, returned result, user amendment, missing worker state, denied dispatch, expired admission, resource block and human pause against the proposed behavior; record expected versus observed judgments.

Human selects the mode and reviews the concrete cutover/rollback and acceptance-authority changes before any operational or production instruction mutation. No existing role, schedule or skill is changed by this spike.
